og_title: AI has started breaking in on its own — Warning Shots: see what’s coming, know what it means for you
og_desc: Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 12 in a year. In 46% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 148 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 25, 7:45 AM ET.

n.title: Unit 42: an AI-run attacker took password hashes and MFA secrets at a European government body in two hours
n.summary: First vendor account of a successful PHP2Shell intrusion; victim unnamed, data source unstated, domain-admin outcome not given.
